'''Big Rock Ranch''' was a destination on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] in the Coruscant underworld.

==Behind the scenes==
The name was inserted onto the subtram map as an in-joke by the production team, along with the other destinations on the map, referencing the section of Skywalker Ranch, which acted as the main studio for [[Lucasfilm]] and its film releases. The name of Skywalker Ranch itself was given in the same episode.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
